message: Last winter, we had a big snowstorm rolling in, and my family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree. My daughter sent a meme about building a snow fort, while my son reminded us not to forget the bread and milk. I chuckled, but it did get me thinking about our supplies. It’s nice to have some fun in the chaos, but a little prep can save a lot of stress down the road. Ever had a chat like that with your family? ❄️
